knowledge.title: Match a company source record to its mastered id on id and source system
knowledge.content: Resolve COMPANY_CORE to COMPANY_CROSS_REFERENCE on SOURCE_UNIQUE_ID and UPPER(REF_GDP_SOURCE_SYSTEM.GDP_SOURCE_SYSTEM_NAME) = UPPER(SOURCE_SYSTEM_NAME). Matching on SOURCE_UNIQUE_ID alone attaches records to the wrong company, because ids collide across sources.

knowledge.title: Resolve companies through the full cross-reference, never the delta
knowledge.content: Use COMPANY_MDM.COMPANY_CROSS_REFERENCE for resolution. STAGE.COMPANY_CROSS_REFERENCE_ENTITY_ID holds only the companies changed in the current run, so resolving through it sets DIM_COMPANY_SKEY to -1 for every record whose company did not change.

knowledge.title: Exclude Reltio-internal cross-reference rows
knowledge.content: Cross-reference rows with SOURCE_SYSTEM_NAME 'Reltio' or 'ReltioGrouping' are internal to MDM (about 40M of 61M rows). Exclude them from lineage, coverage and resolution.

knowledge.title: Use active, latest cross-reference rows and active dimension rows
knowledge.content: Filter COMPANY_CROSS_REFERENCE on GDP_IS_ACTIVE (deleted rows have MDM_DELETED_DATE set or MDM_STATUS 'INACTIVE'), keep the latest row per SOURCE_UNIQUE_ID and SOURCE_SYSTEM_NAME, and read DIM_COMPANY where GDP_IS_ACTIVE with the lowest DIM_COMPANY_SKEY per CBRE_ENTERPRISE_COMPANY_ID. Reading DIM_COMPANY without the active filter attaches records to merged-away companies.

knowledge.title: -1 means unresolved, at two different layers
knowledge.content: A silver COMPANY_CORE_SKEY of -1 means no pre-MDM match; a gold DIM_COMPANY_SKEY of -1 means no MDM or dimension match. Diagnose layer by layer: silver, cross-reference, gold dimension, consumer.

knowledge.title: PDL companies resolve through a name crosswalk, not MDM
knowledge.content: PDL company records do not reach Reltio (0% match); they resolve through SILVER.COMPANY.PDL_COMPANY_DIM_XREF on name and alias.

knowledge.title: DIM_COMPANY holds parent records too
knowledge.content: DIM_COMPANY includes Immediate Parent, Domestic Parent and Global Ultimate records besides companies. Filter COMPANY_TYPE_DESC = 'Company' for organisation-level counts and facts.

knowledge.title: Company merges reach gold only through the cross-reference
knowledge.content: dbt does not read COMPANY_MERGE. A merge shows up as the cross-reference pointing the source record at the surviving mastered id; the losing DIM_COMPANY row stays active until all its cross-reference rows are deleted. Facts keep their old skey until a repoint covers them.

knowledge.title: MDM tables are versioned
knowledge.content: Deduplicate MDM tables to the latest version with ORDER BY MDM_POST_MDM_LUD DESC NULLS LAST, MDM_UPDATED_TS DESC NULLS LAST.
